problem: The wink pack carries no destructive-action pattern. resolve('delete a ritual permanently') -> UNDEFINED; searches for 'delete', 'destructive', 'undo', 'confirm', 'dialog' return no hits. The Cadence consumer improvised the entire flow (outline pill + #BF4055 ring; confirm dialog; undo) as marked improvisation.
insufficiency: The high-consequence confirmation flow is a source-owned decision the pack never carried: docs/synthesis/wink/decisions.json W-16 (destructive, AUTHORED, Gate 2 accepted) - 'High-consequence actions route through a rounded confirm dialog (16px) with a consequence sentence in the warm voice; confirm = ink-filled pill labelled with the concrete verb (never "OK"); cancel = outline pill. Destructive is never the default focus.' Without it, consumers must re-invent consequence copy, verb labelling, and focus rules per app. NOTE: the undo/recovery affordance requested in the same gap is NOT part of this proposal - no source evidence for an undo pattern exists (W-16's rejected alternatives were heavier confirmations, not recovery), so undo stays a marked consumer improvisation.
reuse_case: Any product with destructive actions (delete, cancel, disconnect, deactivate) needs the same confirmation pattern; it recurs in every consumer app and is not Cadence-specific.
composition_check: Existing elements cannot compose it: component/card gives a vessel but no confirm semantics; component/action-pill gives pills but nothing states the concrete-verb rule ('never OK'), the consequence-sentence requirement, or the never-default-focus rule; guideline/voice gives tone but not the flow; recipes.json is empty so COMPOSE cannot fire. One pattern entry is the smallest carrier. (The dialog vessel itself is covered by a sibling proposal pattern/dialog-overlay; depends_on cites only real pack ids per kernel rules.)

proposed.title: Destructive confirmation

states: high-consequence action -> rounded 16px dialog on warm ink scrim with a consequence sentence in the warm voice
confirm = ink-filled pill labelled with the concrete verb (never 'OK')
destructive action never receives default focus
do: state the consequence plainly in the warm voice
label the confirm pill with the concrete verb
dont: no undo/recovery UI is canonical - not evidenced (W-16)

proposed.notes: Content per decisions.json W-16 (accepted). Undo deliberately excluded (no source evidence).

golden.note: Destructive flow resolves to the pattern.

checks: resolve('delete a ritual permanently') must not return UNDEFINED once shipped
a request asserting a canonical undo UI must remain UNDEFINED/marked (no evidence)
